segments.name: Polypropylene recycling
segments.description: Commercializes a patented dissolution recycling technology to restore waste polypropylene into near-virgin resin for customers.
segments.evidence: the Company's Chief Executive Officer , who is also the CODM, makes decisions and manages the Company's operations as a single operating segment, which encompasses integrated business activities related to the recycling of polypropylene into resin pellets.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for recycled and compounded polypropylene resin pellets or co-products, with revenue recognized when control of the product transfers.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue is primarily generated from the sale of recycled and compounded polypropylene resin pellets or co-products to customers.
